title: Extended Warranties? | Beacon
summary: An appliance-repair company's FAQ page argues protection plans are worth it on many appliances, especially ones with more electronics or moving parts.

assertions.quote: In many cases, yes. It depends on the appliance, the type of plan, and how long you plan to keep the product

verdicts.note: Independent data (Consumer Reports, Wirecutter) consistently finds most extended warranties cost more than the repairs they prevent, and failure rates for most appliance categories in the typical coverage window are low.
CR concludes service plans are generally 'money down the drain' and that it's not cost-effective to buy a plan to cover every major purchase; overall buyers save money avoiding them.

assertions.quote: It often makes the most sense on appliances with more electronics, more moving parts, or higher repair costs
the plan may provide a replacement or buyout based on the plan terms

verdicts.note: A standard, verifiable feature of many protection-plan contracts.
